name: shared_domain_composition
summary: A Market family whose distinct Market instances may use one Liquidity Domain only through that Domain Revision's local admission rule.

domain_policy.description: Every Market remains separately identified; shared liquidity exists only where one exact Domain Revision admits that Market and Engine Revision.

asset_roles.description: An exact asset whose accounted inventory is intentionally available to admitted Market instances.

actions.description: Create a new Domain Revision that records an authority-relevant Market admission change.
Use shared inventory only within the exact Market, Engine Revision, asset, and gross limits admitted by the Domain Revision.
